canonical_statement: Gnosis or the interpretation of secret truth grants the individual immunity to death.

attributions.surface_quote: Whoever finds the interpretation of these sayings will not experience death.

canonical_statement: The ultimate state of existence involves a transition through confusion and astonishment to mastery over the totality of reality.

attributions.surface_quote: When he finds, he will become troubled... and he will rule over the All.

canonical_statement: The kingdom of heaven is an immanent reality existing both within and outside the individual.

attributions.surface_quote: The kingdom is inside of you, and it is outside of you.

canonical_statement: Self-knowledge is the prerequisite for divine recognition and the realization of one's origin.

attributions.surface_quote: When you come to know yourselves, then you will become known.

canonical_statement: Ignorance of the self constitutes a state of ontological poverty.

attributions.surface_quote: If you will not know yourselves, you dwell in poverty.

canonical_statement: All hidden aspects of reality are destined to be revealed and made manifest.

attributions.surface_quote: There is nothing hidden which will not become manifest.

canonical_statement: The spiritual evolution of the soul involves the transmutation of lower, animalistic natures into higher, human or divine forms.

attributions.surface_quote: Blessed is the lion which becomes man when consumed by man.

canonical_statement: The material universe and its heavens are transient and subject to dissolution.

attributions.surface_quote: This heaven will pass away, and the one above it will pass away.

canonical_statement: True life is defined by spiritual awakening, while the unawakened are ontologically dead.

attributions.surface_quote: The dead are not alive, and the living will not die.

canonical_statement: Human existence involves a transition from original unity into a state of duality.

attributions.surface_quote: On the day when you were one you became two.

canonical_statement: Spiritual enlightenment is an internal, transformative process rather than an external ritualistic practice.

attributions.surface_quote: If you fast, you will give rise to sin for yourselves.

canonical_statement: Moral defilement is a product of internal intent and expression rather than external consumption.

attributions.surface_quote: What goes into your mouth will not defile you, but that which issues from your mouth.

canonical_statement: The ultimate spiritual origin is non-biological and transcends human birth.

attributions.surface_quote: When you see one who was not born of woman, prostrate yourselves.

canonical_statement: Spiritual realization necessitates a state of individual solitude and separation from worldly structures.

attributions.surface_quote: And they will stand solitary.

canonical_statement: The beginning and the end of existence are ontologically identical.

attributions.surface_quote: Where the beginning is, there will the end be.

canonical_statement: True identity exists prior to the manifestation of the individual in the material world.

attributions.surface_quote: Blessed is he who came into being before he came into being.

canonical_statement: The material world is a temporary domain that does not belong to the soul.

attributions.surface_quote: Children who have settled in a field which is not theirs.

canonical_statement: Entry into the kingdom of heaven requires the dissolution of all dualities and binary distinctions.

attributions.surface_quote: When you make the two one, and the inside like the outside.

canonical_statement: The ultimate state of being involves the unification of the many into a singular essence.

attributions.surface_quote: They shall stand as a single one.

canonical_statement: The individual possesses an internal luminosity that, when active, illuminates the external world.

attributions.surface_quote: There is light within a man of light, and he lights up the whole world.

canonical_statement: Self-correction and the removal of internal biases are prerequisites for accurate perception of others.

attributions.surface_quote: When you cast the beam out of your own eye, then you will see clearly.

canonical_statement: Detachment from worldly concerns is a necessary condition for accessing the divine realm.

attributions.surface_quote: If you do not fast as regards the world, you will not find the kingdom.

canonical_statement: Humanity exists in a state of spiritual unconsciousness or intoxication, unaware of their true nature.

attributions.surface_quote: I found all of them intoxicated; I found none of them thirsty.

canonical_statement: The spirit is the primary source of existence, and its presence within the physical body is a profound paradox.

attributions.surface_quote: I am amazed at how this great wealth has made its home in this poverty.

canonical_statement: The divine presence is accessible to the individual regardless of the plurality of external deities.

attributions.surface_quote: Where there are two or one, I am with him.

canonical_statement: The attainment of spiritual liberation requires the shedding of the ego or false self, symbolized by the removal of garments.

attributions.surface_quote: When you disrobe without being ashamed... then will you see the son of the living one

canonical_statement: Access to divine knowledge is restricted by institutional gatekeepers who prevent others from attaining enlightenment.

attributions.surface_quote: The pharisees and the scribes have taken the keys of knowledge and hidden them.

canonical_statement: Spiritual wisdom requires a synthesis of intellectual discernment and moral purity.

attributions.surface_quote: Be as wise as serpents and as innocent as doves.

canonical_statement: Entities lacking a connection to the divine source are inherently unstable and subject to dissolution.

attributions.surface_quote: A grapevine planted outside the father will be pulled up and destroyed.

canonical_statement: Spiritual progress requires a detachment from worldly identification and a state of transient existence.

attributions.surface_quote: Become passers-by.

canonical_statement: The holy spirit represents an absolute, unforgivable threshold of reality, distinct from the father or son.

attributions.surface_quote: Whoever blasphemes against the holy spirit will not be forgiven.

canonical_statement: External manifestations are direct projections of the internal state of the heart.

attributions.surface_quote: A good man brings forth good from his storehouse in his heart.

canonical_statement: The transition to a higher state of consciousness requires a fundamental shift in identity, surpassing historical spiritual benchmarks.

attributions.surface_quote: Whoever comes to be a child will be acquainted with the kingdom.

canonical_statement: Spiritual integration requires singular focus; dualistic or conflicting states of being are incompatible.

attributions.surface_quote: It is impossible for a man to mount two horses.

canonical_statement: Unity of consciousness between individuals grants the ability to manipulate physical reality.

attributions.surface_quote: If two make peace... they will say to the mountain, 'Move Away'

canonical_statement: The human soul originates from a primordial light-source and is destined to return to it.

attributions.surface_quote: You are from it, and to it you will return.

canonical_statement: The fundamental nature of the divine is characterized by the duality of movement and repose.

attributions.surface_quote: The sign of your father in you is movement and repose.

canonical_statement: The eschatological state of the new world is not a future event but a present, unrecognized reality.

attributions.surface_quote: What you look forward to has already come, but you do not recognize it.

canonical_statement: Spiritual transformation is internal and supersedes physical or ritualistic practices.

attributions.surface_quote: The true circumcision in spirit has become completely profitable.

canonical_statement: The material world is inherently dead; true understanding requires transcending material attachment.

attributions.surface_quote: Whoever has come to understand the world has found (only) a corpse.

canonical_statement: Suffering is a necessary condition for the attainment of true life.

attributions.surface_quote: Blessed is the man who has suffered and found life.

canonical_statement: Spiritual realization must be achieved during physical life to avoid existential dissolution.

attributions.surface_quote: Take heed of the living one while you are alive, lest you die.

canonical_statement: The unawakened state is characterized by a vulnerability to being consumed by external forces.

attributions.surface_quote: Look for a place for yourself within repose, lest you become a corpse and be eaten.

canonical_statement: The ultimate reality is an undivided unity, and individual identity is defined by its relation to this source.

attributions.surface_quote: I am he who exists from the undivided.

canonical_statement: The dissolution of the ego leads to illumination, while fragmentation leads to darkness.

attributions.surface_quote: If he is destroyed, he will be filled with light, but if he is divided, he will be filled with darkness.

canonical_statement: Attachment to material concerns and worldly commerce acts as a barrier to the divine realm.

attributions.surface_quote: Businessmen and merchants will not enter the places of my father.

canonical_statement: Total knowledge of the totality of existence renders any perceived lack of self-sufficiency an absolute deficiency.

attributions.surface_quote: If one who knows the all still feels a personal deficiency, he is completely deficient.

canonical_statement: Internalized persecution or spiritual struggle is a prerequisite for the realization of the divine source.

attributions.surface_quote: Blessed are they who have been persecuted within themselves. It is they who have truly come to know the father.

canonical_statement: Salvation is contingent upon the externalization of an innate, pre-existing internal essence.

attributions.surface_quote: That which you have will save you if you bring it forth from yourselves.

canonical_statement: The material or egoic structure is subject to inevitable dissolution.

attributions.surface_quote: I shall destroy this house, and no one will be able to build it.

canonical_statement: Access to the ultimate state of union is reserved for the solitary individual.

attributions.surface_quote: Many are standing at the door, but it is the solitary who will enter the bridal chamber.

canonical_statement: The highest reality is a singular, enduring essence that necessitates the abandonment of fragmented material attachments.

attributions.surface_quote: He sold the merchandise and bought the pearl alone for himself.

canonical_statement: The ultimate reality is an omnipresent, singular consciousness that permeates all physical matter.

attributions.surface_quote: I am the all... Split a piece of wood, and I am there.

canonical_statement: Spiritual realization grants a consciousness that transcends the material world.

attributions.surface_quote: He who has found the body is superior to the world.

canonical_statement: The divine light is hidden within the manifest images of the material world.

attributions.surface_quote: The images are manifest, but the light in them remains concealed.

canonical_statement: Human existence is characterized by the observation of eternal, pre-existing archetypal images.

attributions.surface_quote: You see your images which came into being before you.

canonical_statement: Dependency on physical or secondary forms is a state of spiritual limitation.

attributions.surface_quote: Wretched is the body that is dependant upon a body.

canonical_statement: Spiritual attainment involves the recognition of inherent, pre-existing divine knowledge.

attributions.surface_quote: Angels will give you those things you already have.

canonical_statement: The creator of the internal essence and the external form is a singular entity.

attributions.surface_quote: he who made the inside is the same one who made the outside

canonical_statement: The present moment contains a hidden reality that observers fail to perceive.

attributions.surface_quote: you do not know how to read this moment

canonical_statement: The kingdom of the father acts as a transformative, pervasive influence within material reality.

attributions.surface_quote: kingdom is like leaven concealed in dough

canonical_statement: Spiritual kinship is defined by alignment with divine will rather than biological lineage.

attributions.surface_quote: Those here who do the will of my father are my brothers

canonical_statement: Spiritual lineage transcends biological parentage.

attributions.surface_quote: my true mother gave me life.

canonical_statement: The unification of duality is the prerequisite for mastery over material reality.

attributions.surface_quote: When you make the two one... 'Mountain, move away,' it will move away.

canonical_statement: The assimilation of the teacher's essence leads to the revelation of hidden truths.

attributions.surface_quote: He who will drink from my mouth will become like me.

canonical_statement: The material world is a hidden repository of value that remains unrecognized by the unawakened.

attributions.surface_quote: The kingdom is like a man who had a hidden treasure in his field.

canonical_statement: The ultimate reality is transient and subject to dissolution in the presence of the awakened consciousness.

attributions.surface_quote: The heavens and the earth will be rolled up in your presence.

canonical_statement: True life is found in the living source, rendering the individual immune to death.

attributions.surface_quote: the one who lives from the living one will not see death.

canonical_statement: Self-actualization confers superiority over the material world.

attributions.surface_quote: Whoever finds himself is superior to the world.

canonical_statement: The soul and the flesh must exist in independence rather than mutual dependency.

attributions.surface_quote: Woe to the flesh that depends on the soul; woe to the soul that depends on the flesh.

canonical_statement: The kingdom of the divine is an omnipresent reality currently obscured by human perception.

attributions.surface_quote: the kingdom of the father is spread out upon the earth, and men do not see it.

canonical_statement: Spiritual attainment requires the transcendence of gendered identity to achieve a unified, living spirit.

attributions.surface_quote: every woman who will make herself male will enter the kingdom of heaven.
